merchant/30178.htm.text: Merchant Zenkin: Come on in, customer! Welcome to the most honest shop in northern Aden. There are people spreading nonsense that I, Zenkin, am a wanted criminal from Elmore or a disguised Timak Orc. Can you believe those lunatics? Well, you look like you can tell a hawk from a handsaw, so I trust …

links.text: Ask about the local lord and tax rate.

merchant/30178-1.htm.text: Merchant Zenkin: Choose whatever you want! Warrior? Wizard? We have it all!

merchant/30178-pk.htm.text: Merchant Zenkin: Welcome! ..Were you expecting me to say that? Hold it right there! Hey, Raudia, are the new axes over there? Give me one.

Q00234_FatesWhisper/30178-01.html.text: Trader Zenkin: Maestro Reorin's Mold? Yes, I bought it from him a year ago. I got a great deal on it. Actually, since it was a tool used by such a famous artisan, I was ready to pay considerably more for it. When I saw how cheaply he had it priced I snatched it right up. As soon as I gave him the A…

links.text: "I would like to buy the mold from you."

Q00234_FatesWhisper/30178-03.html.text: Trader Zenkin: You again? I told you already... I sold Maestro Reorin's Mold. Why don't you go ask Magister Kaspar about it. He is at Hardin's Academy .

Q00234_FatesWhisper/30178-04.html.text: Trader Zenkin: I'm so glad things turned out well. I'm anxious to see Maestro Reorin's new work! I wonder what kind of awesome weapon he will create this time?

Q00234_FatesWhisper/30178-02.html.text: Trader Zenkin: What can I do? I already sold it to someone else. Think about it! That mold was used by one of the 10 finest artisans in the kingdom. Wouldn't everyone want it? Hmm...I can take a look at my account book to see if I recorded who purchased it... Yes, here it is! A few months ago, Magi…

Q00234_FatesWhisper/30182-02.html.text: Warehouse Freightman Cliff: Why do you seek Infernium Varnish? Don't tell me that Maestro Reorin is fooling around with demons again! He should know better than that, after what happened with the demon Hallate... He was tricked into making scepters for them! Oh, that's not it this time, eh?

links.text: "All the scepters have been recovered from the demons."

Q00234_FatesWhisper/30182-03.html.text: Warehouse Freightman Cliff: Very impressive! All the scepters! How wonderful! I must report this to the superiors at the guild! Perhaps they will reconsider his banishment for "dealings with demons". What does he intend to do with the scepters?

links.text: "He will melt them down in order to create something else."

Q00234_FatesWhisper/30182-04.html.text: Warehouse Freightman Cliff: Splendid! What is he going to make? I can't wait to see it! Here you go, take this Infernium Varnish to the maestro immediately! I knew this stuff would come in handy someday... Now I am off to see the guild elders and tell them of the recovery of the scepters. Perhaps h…
